scenarios.label: Patchwerk
scenarios.description: Static targets, all alive for the full fight. The clean laboratory read on sustained throughput and on how much damage a spec can aim at one target.

scenarios.label: Add Waves
scenarios.description: A boss for the whole fight plus waves of five adds arriving every minute and staying twenty seconds. The scenario funnelling is actually about: does having adds up make the boss die faster, or does the area damage cost it?

scenarios.label: Hectic Add Cleave
scenarios.description: A boss plus adds that spawn and despawn throughout the fight. Realistic raid cleave, including the ramp and refresh cost of moving damage between targets.

scenarios.label: Dungeon Slice (M+)
scenarios.description: SimulationCraft's Mythic+ approximation: a boss followed by interleaved trash packs, averaging about four targets over roughly six minutes.

scenarios.label: Entombed Sentinels
scenarios.description: Entombed Sentinels as logged: 3 target(s) at the pull, 0 add wave(s), 0 damage amplification window(s), 0 window(s) with the boss unattackable. Built from a fight profile, not a fight style.
